Class: one single cute building for a strategy game's town screen, a toy model seen in three-quarter view from slightly above: its front, one side and its roof. Big, chunky, rounded toy-like shapes with a thick black outline, saturated flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, a characterful silhouette with one oversized signature feature. Whole and centred, filling the image; alone on a transparent background, nothing under it.

Subject: each image a different one of these 5 ramshackle goblin buildings, three takes of each in this order: Launch Ramp (a tall chunky wooden ramp with a big spring at its foot); Great Flinger (a giant catapult of logs and tin with a yellow arm); Magic Guild (a crooked hide and tin shaman tower with a lightning rod); Tavern (a tin grog shack with a yellow roof, barrels and a mug sign); Resource Silo (a fat tin silo beside a woodpile and an ore wheelbarrow). Colours: riveted light grey tin #b8bcc0 with #7d8288 shadows, bright hazard yellow #f2c230 roofs, sharpened logs #b8733a, tawny spotted hide.

style_image.usage: copy the palette, the thick black outline, the pixel size and the chunky rounded toy-like shapes of its shacks; not the layout: draw only one building
